# ERDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasERDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasERDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasERDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasERDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A database schema (Chen, Chen min-max/ISO, Crow's Foot)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasERDiagram](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasERDiagram.md)
- [UltraCanvasERDiagramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasERDiagramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasERDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasERDiagramProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasERDiagram> CreateERDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasERDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&, const std::vector<std::string>&)> onSelectionChange` | (entityIds, relationshipIds) |

## Option types in this header

### enum `ERNotation`

Notation family. All three render the same model; they differ in where attributes live and how cardinality is drawn.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Chen` | Rectangles / diamonds / satellite ovals, 1-N-M edge letters |
| `ChenMinMax` | As Chen, with (min,max) ISO cardinality pairs on every leg |
| `CrowsFoot` | Attribute-row boxes, relationship drawn as the edge itself |

### enum `ERDiagramEntityKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Strong` | Rectangle |
| `Weak` | Double rectangle - identified through an owner |
| `Associative` | Rectangle enclosing a diamond - resolves an M:N |

### enum `ERAttributeKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Simple` |  |
| `Composite` | Has child attributes on their own spokes |
| `MultiValued` | Double oval |
| `Derived` | Dashed oval |

### enum `ERKeyRole`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoKey` | Named NoKey, not None - X11's Xlib.h defines None as a macro |
| `Primary` | Solid underline |
| `Partial` | Dashed underline - weak entity's discriminator |
| `Foreign` |  |
| `Unique` |  |

### enum `ERRelationshipKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Regular` | Diamond |
| `Identifying` | Double diamond - owner of a weak entity |

### enum `ERParticipation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Partial` | Single line |
| `Total` | Double line |
| `Optional` | Dashed line |

### enum `ERCardinality`

The four cardinalities every notation agrees on. Anything else is expressed through the leg's explicit minCard/maxCard.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ExactlyOne` | (1,1) \|\| |
| `ZeroOrOne` | (0,1) o\| |
| `OneOrMany` | (1,N) \|{ |
| `ZeroOrMany` | (0,N) o{ |

### enum `ERLineEndStyle`

Marker drawn at the entity end of a leg. Deliberately independent of the notation so Chen bodies can carry crow's-foot ends (reference image 1).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoMarker` |  |
| `Tick` | Single crossbar - "one" |
| `DoubleTick` | Two crossbars - "exactly one" |
| `CrowsFoot` | Three-pronged fan - "many" |
| `CircleCrowsFoot` | Circle + fan - "zero or many, optional" |
| `Circle` | Circle - "zero or one" |
| `Arrow` |  |
| `FilledDot` |  |

### enum `ERCardinalityLabels`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLabels` |  |
| `Letters` | 1 / N / M / P |
| `MinMax` | (1,1) (1,N) (0,N) |
| `UML` | 1 / 0..1 / 1..* / 0..* |

### enum `ERDiagramLayout`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Manual` |  |
| `AttributeSatellite` | Ovals fanned around their entity, away from its legs |
| `Spine` | entity-relationship-entity chains on one axis |
| `ForceDirected` | Entities + relationship nodes as bodies |
| `Symmetric` | Two entities, relationship centred between them |

### enum `ERConnectorStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Straight` |  |
| `Orthogonal` | Elbow with rounded corners |
| `Bezier` |  |

| `Colorful` |  |
| `Pastel` |  |
| `Dark` |  |

### struct `ERDiagramLeg`

One participation of an entity in a relationship. Two legs = binary, three or more = n-ary (reference image 5).

| `roleName` | `std::string roleName` | Disambiguates the ends of a recursive relationship |
